title: Steak Salad With a Vietnamese Flair
description: To put some wow in a weeknight – without breaking a sweat – try this Vietnamese Grilled Steak Salad. The steaks grill in a flash and the authentic flavors in the sweet-savory dressing pull it all together. Delish!
ingredients: 2 carrots, sliced into ribbons using a peeler
¼ wombok (Chinese cabbage), or baby bok choy, finely shredded
1 cucumber, sliced into ribbons using a peeler
150 g (5 oz) snow peas, par-boiled, sliced diagonally
¼ cup peanuts (plain, unsalted), chopped, to serve
1 small red chilli pepper, finely chopped, or a dash of red pepper flakes
directions: Brush steaks with oil and season with salt & pepper. Place a chargrill pan over high heat and cook steak for 3 minutes each side for medium rare or until cooked to your liking. Rest.
Peel carrot into ribbons with a vegetable peeler and, together with the cabbage, toss with the rice vinegar. Leave to pickle for 10 minutes.
Cover vermicelli in boiling water for 5 minutes or until tender, drain and rinse with cold water, drain again. Combine the dressing ingredients.
Combine cabbage, carrot plus pickling liquid, vermicelli, cucumber, snow peas and mint leaves and toss with dressing. Top salad with sliced beef and peanuts.
